# Stahl Capital

> A local-first, native desktop app for tracking investment portfolios, built on portfolio_rs and written in Rust on Rune, with no web view. For macOS, Linux and Windows. Free and MIT licensed. It is an early alpha, so expect rough edges.

Stahl Capital is software, not a bank, a broker or an adviser. The page's private bank voice is a joke about having one client: you. Nothing it shows is investment advice.

## What it does

- Overview: what changed since you last looked, the total value, and what to look at
- Holdings: a sortable, searchable table or a map, with cost basis and purchases
- Allocation: today's split against your policy's targets
- Performance: time-weighted return, separating market moves from money you added
- Review, in a workspace: drift, constraint checks, data quality and suggested actions
- Rebalance, in a workspace: a what-if plan you drag, or where new money should go. It never trades.
- Policy, in a workspace: a machine-readable investment policy
- Documents, in a workspace: weekly reports and decision records
- Briefing: a summary with Copy as Markdown, to hand to an AI assistant
- Counsel: questions answered with live blocks from the app's own figures, by the AI provider you set or by the app itself; the model never writes a figure
- Data Health: file validation, data-quality findings and workspace checks

## Your data

Positions are in a plain JSON file on your machine, shared with the portfolio_rs CLI. A file that doesn't parse shows its line and column. It is never shown as an empty portfolio and never overwritten.

Three things can leave the machine: tickers sent to Yahoo Finance to fetch prices (set `PORTFOLIO_RS_QUOTES=offline` to stop that); the question you ask Counsel when you have set an AI provider in Settings, which carries the figures on the page, the policy review, the briefing, the conversation so far and your key in a header, with amounts hidden in privacy mode (a local provider is never asked about; any other host is shown the exact request once); and one request to api.github.com on launch to check for a newer version (set `STAHL_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` to skip it). There's no account and no telemetry.

## Install

- Run without installing: `nix run github:MarkusZoppelt/stahl`
- Install with Nix: `nix profile install github:MarkusZoppelt/stahl`
- Installers (.dmg for Apple silicon, .deb for x64, .zip for Windows x64): https://github.com/MarkusZoppelt/stahl/releases
- macOS builds are ad-hoc signed, so right-click the app and choose Open on first launch.
